tool_notes: SCP795 Single Cell Portal bulk download requires signed-in Broad account (blocked for anon). GEO GSE165371 supplementary provides anonymous mtx bundles; interneuron_joint bundle (454MB) holds 60526 MLI+PLI nuclei as genes x cells integer mtx WITHOUT cluster labels. Cluster labels sourced from public MacoskoLab/cerebellum-atlas-analysis repo data/cluster_metadata.csv (barcode -> subcluster/cluster). 45555/60526 mtx barcodes matched final interneuron subclusters; 14971 unmatched (QC-removed / not-final-annotated). Golgi clusters absent from interneuron_joint bundle (separate golgi_joint.tar.gz); target at_source_sets are MLI/PLI only. NOTE spelling: dataset uses PLI_1/PLI_2/PLI_3 (underscore) not PLI1/PLI2/PLI3. PLI_1=1176(candelabrum), PLI_2=735(globular), PLI_3=531(Lugaro) counts match paper.
